name: dev-server
description: Starts the project's server, the command its config names, in /workspace at every boot of the container, and gives the agent a helper to restart it. Its ports are published when the project lists them in PORTS (src/services/ports/lease.py). Nothing configured → does nothing.

settings.label: Command
settings.description: Started in /workspace at every boot of the container. Empty: nothing is started.
